title: What you need to know about pest-proofing your business
summary: Pests can harm your business and your reputation. Learn why pest-proofing is crucial and how commercial pest control from Rentokil helps protect businesses.
body_markdown:
## How to pest-proof your business


Pest activity in buildings has always been a daily problem for businesses. Unwanted pests in your business can cause all types of damage and be a health risk to you, your employees, and your customers. The best way to get ahead of the problem is to prevent these pests from entering in the first place.


Pest exclusion services are a key part of Rentokil’s[integrated pest management (IPM)](https://www.rentokil.com/us/pest-control/integrated-pest-management) program because they prevent pests from entering your building and prohibit movement. Rentokil’s IPM services are designed to protect your business from unwanted pests by identifying the root of the problem and implementing practical solutions. Our technicians will work with you to develop a customized plan tailored to your business’s needs.


## Top pests in your business


Pests can be a major nuisance to any business and can do more than just cause damage or pose health risks – they can also create a wrong impression for your business. Pests can make your business seem dirty, unsanitary, and unprofessional. Here are a few of the most common pests to look out for:


- **Rodents** , like[mice](https://www.rentokil.com/us/pest-control/mouse-control) and[rats](https://www.rentokil.com/us/pest-control/rat-control) , can cause significant damage by chewing through structures, equipment, electrical wires, etc. Mice can fit through openings as small as ¼”, while rats can squeeze through spaces as small as ½”.
- [Birds](https://www.rentokil.com/us/pest-control/bird-control) **and**[bats](https://www.rentokil.com/us/pest-control/wildlife-control/bats) can be noisy, messy, and unhygienic. Their droppings can carry diseases and pose a potential health risk. Feral pigeons can enter your property through just a two-inch opening, while the English House Sparrows only need a ¾” opening. Bats can squeeze through openings as small as ⅜”.


- [Nuisance wildlife](https://www.rentokil.com/us/pest-control/wildlife-control) , such as[squirrels](https://www.rentokil.com/us/pest-control/wildlife-control/squirrels) ,[opossums](https://www.rentokil.com/us/pest-control/wildlife-control/opossum) , and[raccoons](https://www.rentokil.com/us/pest-control/wildlife-control/raccoons) , can cause significant damage by chewing through wires and insulation and entering buildings through roof vents or open windows.
- **Larger overwintering insects** , such as large[cockroaches](https://www.rentokil.com/us/pest-control/cockroach-control) , brown marmorated stink bugs, and Asian lady beetles, can easily damage your business’s reputation. Cockroaches can carry all kinds of bacteria and diseases, and only need 1/16” openings to enter your company.


## Pest solutions to prevent pest infestations for your business


Pest-proofing your business acts as a first line of defense and, when paired with a comprehensive pest management plan, can help exclude pests from your business. Rentokil uses a comprehensive suite of[Flexi Armour™](https://www.rentokil.com/us/pest-control/exclusion) products alongside other innovative pest exclusion solutions, including:


- **Flexi Armour Seal** is a hybrid material consisting of a polymer compound mixed with stainless steel to seal structural holes or gaps. It can bond to almost any surface and be painted after curing.
- **Flexi Armour Shield** , a proofing tape built with durable stainless mesh, may be used to seal any smaller holes or gaps around your business. It leaves no residue after removal and can withstand most weather conditions.
- **Flexi Armour Dock** is made of durable Kevlar and steel mesh with a softer, gap-filling material. It offers an advanced, movement-tolerant solution to keep rodents out of the gaps around dock levelers.
- **Flexi Armour Doors** is a selection of durable, extruded rubber products featuring a distinctive knitted mesh core. It is expertly engineered to block rodent entry from interior and exterior gaps between the door and floor.
- **Flexi Armour Expansion** combines a durable, flexible stainless steel mesh with a distinctive self-leveling compound to seal expansion joints from rodents chewing through and accessing openings.
- **Flexi Armour Ground Mesh** is a durable, anti-corrosion barrier for the ground. Its robust construction safeguards your business premises from underground pest invasions.
- **Flexi Armour Weep** is a flexible, cut-to-size, knitted mesh tube made from stainless steel. It is designed to block wall cavities and prevent rodents from entering buildings.
- **Flexi Armour Garage Door Seal** provides a reliable barrier that pest-proofs your business by tightly sealing garage entries and helps to prevent insects and rodents from infiltrating your facility.
- **Rentokil Dual Autogate** is explicitly designed to detect rodents.[Dual Autogate](https://www.rentokil.com/us/pest-control/pestconnect/dual-autogate-connect) is part of our PestConnect system, a network of connected devices that detects, captures, and humanely eliminates rodent pests with innovative and highly effective traps, bait stations, and monitors
- **Vent caps** cover and protect vents from large pests while still allowing air to flow.
